description: §66.3 rule 6: `let <k=(1 + 2)/>` infers the base type `int` (never the literal singleton `3`), so the write `@k = 7` is accepted and lands (3 → 7).
rationale: §66.3 rule 6: "The inferred type is the BASE type — never a literal singleton (`<n=(1 + 2)/>` is `int`, not `3`)". ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "go on the package" (dd own-value-type-annotation-o35d-dpa-065 §8 ruling 4).
